subject: cul-tf-s
title: CUL.TF.S.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 86 ((AF)D-14). CUL-TF-S (cultural transfer shifts) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: C-INFO (composite information). INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from the subject. From C-INFO: AFL (affinity alignment). From AFL: TH-CONT (thrust continuance) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From TH-CONT: IST-F (isolated focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis). From MT-INFO: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From IST-F: LANG-DY (language dynamics). IST-F-2 (isolated focus) is on a dotted line from IST-F. S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation) is on a dotted line from LANG-DY.
